requirements.quote: Check the exact joined local circular walls with material-qa-policy.json. Retain source geometry and raw intersection values; check connected material union, independent source volume, two-boundary bore topology and finite central-core probes at every local interface. Failures must block drawing. Numerical geometry checks do not establish product joints, installation, full-bore CFD, whole-network pressure or Hong Kong compliance.
requirements.acceptance: Scoped ideal material/topology/probe checks only; physical products and full engineering acceptance remain pending

requirements.quote: Use extended-pressure-policy.json to extend the inherited prescribed-flow budget to the two outer open source-wall caps of the exact material-checked local chain. Derive every length, bore and cap elevation from saved/native source evidence, retain original per-body K and separately declared source-wall and additional interface losses. Apply unchanged numeric source/terminal pressure values at the explicitly changed stations and inherited roughness to all local walls. Retain a per-body pressure ledger, pressure failures and drawing gates; do not claim ambient-gauge fan duty or complete installation acceptance.
requirements.acceptance: Explicitly extended local pressure budget; full fan/product/installation/regulatory review remains pending

requirements.quote: Solve the exact selected source curve from circular-fan-catalogue.json against the extended material-checked circular path. Reconstruct catalogue preferences and every candidate before handoff; do not supply a replacement curve/model. Keep the original airflow as minimum duty and preserve velocity/terminal-pressure targets. Rerun the selected operating network independently and gate drawing on numerical success; actual fan equipment, flow metadata, motor input and full engineering remain pending.
requirements.acceptance: Source-bounded free-flow numerical operating point only; full engineering review pending

requirements.quote: Screen every candidate in circular-fan-catalogue.json on the same verified pressure/native source. Retain weak and unsupported candidates, apply the declared preference and lexical tie break among eligible results, and freshly rerun the selected curve. If no candidate is feasible or a preferred mechanical identity remains unresolved, create no selected scenario and block the independent operating consumer and drawing. These synthetic curves and preferences are not real product approval.
requirements.acceptance: Source-declared finite numerical/mechanical eligibility screening, not installed product approval
